scope: Bounded primary-paper and repository source audit; no novelty, performance validation or absence-of-prior-art claim.
statement: The cited 2026 preprints report subquadratic-preprocessing integer 3SUM indexing and current-output-sensitive function-inversion reporting; neither automatically gives the required charged elliptic implicit index. Semaev2015 already specifies ground-field S3 auxiliaries. The companion monic-oracle source uses a quadratic unordered-S3-pair reference and a separate balanced coefficient check, not the maintained linear group-complement scan. Exact source and theorem references are retained.
